fields.dataset_id: Stable chart/dataset ID; never reassign IDs to other metrics.
fields.series_id: Stable ID derived from dataset ID and exact series name; name changes create a new series.
fields.date: Source observation period/date, ISO 8601. Monthly dates may use day 01; see dataset note.
fields.value: Number or null. Missing is not zero. SQL NULL / JSON null / empty CSV.
fields.unit: Source unit; indices are NOT absolute quantities.
fields.point_label: Qualification such as above/approximately/partial week; retain when reusing.
fields.dataset_sources: Dataset source URLs separated by |; includes attribution links.
fields.archive_version: Version of this export, NOT a per-point fetched timestamp.

semantics: Exports are chart-ready retained observations, not necessarily raw measurements. Download metrics are trailing seven-day sums. Ramp indices can be rebased; blocked merges retain old data. Do not interpolate disclosure points or convert null to zero. Raw source payloads and revisions are under ../archive/.
license: Underlying sources retain their rights. OpenRouter data requires CC BY 4.0 attribution. This export does not grant additional rights.
timestamps: archive_updated_at identifies the retained archive version, not proof every source was checked. See refresh-status.json for collection failures and unreviewed sources.
